summary_en: Nihon Kogyo executed a block purchase of 380,000 shares (12.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) at 1,143 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 5, 2026, as part of a 400,000-share authorization up to 600 million yen approved on October 27, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Nihon Kogyo executed a block purchase of 380,000 shares of its own common stock at 1,143 yen per share on November 5, 2026, using ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading. This execution represents 12.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock and was carried out as part of a broader authorization approved by the board on October 27, 2026, which permits the acquisition of up to 400,000 shares (13.61% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 600 million yen through March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is intended to enhance shareholder returns marking its 70th anniversary, expand the employee stock compensation program as part of human capital initiatives, and secure shares for use in M&A transactions and corporate alliances. The purchase price of 1,143 yen was based on the closing price on November 4, 2026. The company noted that its principal shareholder, Sekisui Jushi Corporation, has expressed an intention to sell part of its holding in Nihon Kogyo, which may result in changes to major shareholder composition depending on the buyback results.
